The '''Imperial Pacification Droid''' was a [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] model that could be seen throughout [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith]] [[Sith Worlds/Legends|planets]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. There were several varieties of this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] type.
